task.subject: Ontology cross-pillar grant renewal kernel slice
task.description:
ChangeSet: cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-renewal-kernel-fd001-alignment.
Objective: continue FD-001 ontology depth after tasks 30/32 by adding a pure ontology-kernel renewal path for CrossPillarGrant so a cross-pillar grant cannot be silently extended without fresh two-person authorization and audit-ready renewal evidence.
Authority anchors: specs/root-hub-pointers.json -> docs/AGENTS.md -> specs/masterplan.json FD-001 surfaces include ontology and require tenant isolation/auditability -> specs/master-plan-sequencing.json -> microservices/ontology/IP-013-pillar-cross-pillar-grant.md -> microservices/ontology/policy/type-isolation.md TI-12. Relevant live spec text: cross-pillar grants use 2-person rule, TTL <= 30d unless explicitly renewed, audit-chained at issuance + renewal + revocation; audit trail fields include grant_id/principal/allowed_pillars/data_class_cap/expires_at/signed_by[2] and used target_resource_id.
Write scope: ONLY /Users/jasonlee/oyatie-worktrees/fd001-worker3-ontology-schema-revision-20260520T122217Z/crates/oya-ontology-kernel/src/pillar.rs and exact evidence paths evidence/fd001/cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-renewal-kernel-fd001-alignment-* plus evidence/multispectrum/cs-ontology-cross-pillar-grant-renewal-kernel-fd001-alignment.json. Do not touch Cargo/root manifests/contracts/registries/adapters/docs or other workers' scopes.
Implementation shape: domain-only, zero I/O, no placeholder/stub. Extend existing CrossPillarGrant/CrossPillarGrantAuditEvent patterns from tasks 30/32 with a deterministic renewal API (or equivalent pure constructor) that takes the existing grant, renewal timestamp, new expiration, and fresh signed_by_two_principals; enforces existing grant is valid at renewal time, same principal/source/target/data_class_cap, <=30d renewed TTL window, strictly later expiration, two distinct non-empty signers excluding subject principal, and refuses expired/wrong-target/same-pillar/malformed renewals. Add a stable audit event kind/label/retention for renewed grants with renewal timestamp, previous_expires_at, renewed_expires_at, and renewal signers.
Required steps: read current pillar.rs/tests and type-isolation/IP-013 anchors before editing; run planning-closure start gate; run Oya VCS claim for crates/oya-ontology-kernel/src/pillar.rs::CrossPillarGrantRenewal; implement with focused tests; verify cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo test -p oya-ontology-kernel -- --nocapture, cargo nextest run -p oya-ontology-kernel, cargo clippy -p oya-ontology-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings, planning-closure, data-class, architecture-boundaries, catalog, dependency-seam, oya git diff --check; Oya VCS verify/done/promote; commit with Lore trailers; transition task complete and report evidence. If any gate is infeasible, record exact blocker and next-best evidence; do not claim done without current evidence.
